name: SHARP-16
description: An accumulator machine built as a compiler target: A and B for expressions, a stack with a frame pointer and an address adder for locals and parameters, CALL, ENTER and RET k for calls, and a multiplier for *, / and %. Its programs are compiled from a subset of C#.
readme:
# SHARP-16

A machine built to be the target of a compiler. It runs a small subset of C#: `static` methods with parameters, locals and recursion, `int`, `bool`, `char` and `string`, arrays, `if`, loops and `switch`, and `Console.Write` to the LCD. The compiler and a live editor that shows the assembly as you type come with it.

## The idea

A compiler wants three things from a machine: somewhere to work out an expression, somewhere to keep a function's variables, and a cheap way to call and return. SHARP-16 has one of each.

- **An accumulator and a second operand.** Every expression ends up in [A](exuarch:device/acc). A binary operation works on B and A and leaves the result in A: `ADD` is A = B + A. The compiler puts the left side in B with [TAB](exuarch:instruction/TAB) when the right side is simple, and on the stack with [PUSH](exuarch:instruction/PUSH) and [POP](exuarch:instruction/POP) when it is not.
- **A frame pointer and an address adder.** A function's parameters and locals sit at fixed distances from [FP](exuarch:device/fp), so the compiler knows each one's offset. [LDL](exuarch:instruction/LDL) and [STL](exuarch:instruction/STL) take that offset and the [ADDRESS ADDER](exuarch:device/agu), a second ALU wired to FP and OFFSET, works out the address without touching A, B or the flags.
- **Calls that build their own frames.** [CALL](exuarch:instruction/CALL) pushes the return address, [ENTER](exuarch:instruction/ENTER) n saves FP and makes room for n locals, and [RET](exuarch:instruction/RET) k puts everything back and drops the k - 2 arguments the caller pushed.

## A frame

The stack grows down from the top of memory and SP points at the top item. Every register starts at 0, so the first push wraps SP round to 65535.

| Address | Holds |
|---|---|
| FP + 2 ... | the arguments, the last one nearest |
| FP + 1 | the return address |
| FP | the caller's FP |
| FP - 1 ... | the locals |

For `static int Add(int a, int b)`, `a` is at FP + 3 and `b` at FP + 2, and the method ends with `RET 4`.

## Arithmetic

[MUL](exuarch:instruction/MUL), [DIV](exuarch:instruction/DIV) and [MOD](exuarch:instruction/MOD) use the [MULTIPLIER](exuarch:device/mac), with its shift at 0 so it works on whole numbers. Division rounds toward 0 and the remainder takes the sign of the dividend, as in C#. A product that does not fit in 16 bits saturates at -32768 or 32767 instead of wrapping, and dividing by 0 gives 32767 or -32768 rather than an exception.

The jumps after [CMP](exuarch:instruction/CMP) are signed: [JLT](exuarch:instruction/JLT) jumps when N and V differ, [JGT](exuarch:instruction/JGT) when Z is clear and N and V agree.

## Things to try

1. Open a program, switch on ⚡ Max and run it.
2. Step through `CALL`, `ENTER` and `RET` and watch SP and FP build and take down a frame.
3. Write C# in the SHARP-16 editor, download the package with your program in it and import it here.

programs.name: Hello and Fibonacci
programs.description: Recursion through CALL, ENTER and RET, and an interpolated string
programs.source:
; Compiled from C# by SharpC for SHARP-16
;
;   using System;
;
;   class Program
;   {
;       static int Fib(int n) => n < 2 ? n : Fib(n - 1) + Fib(n - 2);
;
;       static void Main()
;       {
;           Console.WriteLine("Hello from C# on SHARP-16!");
;           for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++)
;               Console.Write($"{Fib(i)} ");
;       }
;   }

; SHARP-16 assembly, compiled from C# by SharpC

        CALL   Main
        HLT

; 5: static int Fib(int n) => n < 2 ? n : Fib(n - 1) + Fib(n - 2);
Fib:    ENTER  0        ; n FP+2
        LDL    2
        TAB
        LDI    2
        CMP
        JGE    __else1
        LDL    2
        JMP    __endif2
__else1:
        LDL    2
        DEC
        PUSH
        CALL   Fib
        PUSH
        LDL    2
        TAB
        LDI    2
        SUB
        PUSH
        CALL   Fib
        POP
        ADD
__endif2:
        RET    3

; 7: static void Main()
Main:   ENTER  1        ; i FP-1
; 9: Console.WriteLine("Hello from C# on SHARP-16!");
        LEA    __str0
        CALL   __print_str
        LDI    10
        OUT
; 10: for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++)
        LDI    0
        STL    -1
        JMP    __test5
__loop3:
; 11: Console.Write($"{Fib(i)} ");
        LDL    -1
        PUSH
        CALL   Fib
        CALL   __print_int
        LDI    ' '
        OUT
; 10: for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++)
        LDL    -1
        INC
        STL    -1
__test5:
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    15
        CMP
        JLT    __loop3
        RET    2

; Prints the 0-terminated string at the address in A
__print_str:
        ENTER  1
        STL    -1
__ps_loop:
        LDL    -1
        LDX
        TST
        JEQ    __ps_done
        OUT
        LDL    -1
        INC
        STL    -1
        JMP    __ps_loop
__ps_done:
        RET    2

; Prints A as a signed decimal number
__print_int:
        TST
        JGE    __pu            ; not negative: print the digits
        TAB
        LDI    '-'
        OUT
        LDI    -32768
        CMP
        JEQ    __pi_min        ; -32768 has no positive twin
        TBA
        NEG
        JMP    __pu
__pi_min:
        LEA    __s_min
        JMP    __print_str

; Prints A, 0 to 32767, in decimal: the digits in front first, by recursion
__pu:
        ENTER  1
        STL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    10
        DIV
        TST
        JEQ    __pu_last
        CALL   __pu
__pu_last:
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    10
        MOD
        TAB
        LDI    '0'
        ADD
        OUT
        RET    2

; Data
__str0:   .STRING "Hello from C# on SHARP-16!"
__s_min:  .STRING "32768"

programs.source:
; Compiled from C# by SharpC for SHARP-16
;
;   using System;
;
;   class FizzBuzz
;   {
;       static void Main()
;       {
;           for (int i = 1; i <= 30; i++)
;           {
;               switch (i % 15)
;               {
;                   case 0: Console.Write("FizzBuzz"); break;
;                   case 3: case 6: case 9: case 12: Console.Write("Fizz"); break;
;                   case 5: case 10: Console.Write("Buzz"); break;
;                   default: Console.Write(i); break;
;               }
;               Console.Write(' ');
;           }
;       }
;   }

; SHARP-16 assembly, compiled from C# by SharpC

        CALL   Main
        HLT

; 5: static void Main()
Main:   ENTER  1        ; i FP-1
; 7: for (int i = 1; i <= 30; i++)
        LDI    1
        STL    -1
        JMP    __test3
__loop1:
; 9: switch (i % 15)
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    15
        MOD
        TAB
        LDI    0
        CMP
        JEQ    __case6
        LDI    3
        CMP
        JEQ    __case7
        LDI    6
        CMP
        JEQ    __case7
        LDI    9
        CMP
        JEQ    __case7
        LDI    12
        CMP
        JEQ    __case7
        LDI    5
        CMP
        JEQ    __case8
        LDI    10
        CMP
        JEQ    __case8
        JMP    __case9
__case6:
; 11: case 0: Console.Write("FizzBuzz"); break;
        LEA    __str0
        CALL   __print_str
        JMP    __endswitch5
__case7:
; 12: case 3: case 6: case 9: case 12: Console.Write("Fizz"); break;
        LEA    __str1
        CALL   __print_str
        JMP    __endswitch5
__case8:
; 13: case 5: case 10: Console.Write("Buzz"); break;
        LEA    __str2
        CALL   __print_str
        JMP    __endswitch5
__case9:
; 14: default: Console.Write(i); break;
        LDL    -1
        CALL   __print_int
__endswitch5:
; 16: Console.Write(' ');
        LDI    ' '
        OUT
; 7: for (int i = 1; i <= 30; i++)
        LDL    -1
        INC
        STL    -1
__test3:
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    30
        CMP
        JLE    __loop1
        RET    2

; Prints the 0-terminated string at the address in A
__print_str:
        ENTER  1
        STL    -1
__ps_loop:
        LDL    -1
        LDX
        TST
        JEQ    __ps_done
        OUT
        LDL    -1
        INC
        STL    -1
        JMP    __ps_loop
__ps_done:
        RET    2

; Prints A as a signed decimal number
__print_int:
        TST
        JGE    __pu            ; not negative: print the digits
        TAB
        LDI    '-'
        OUT
        LDI    -32768
        CMP
        JEQ    __pi_min        ; -32768 has no positive twin
        TBA
        NEG
        JMP    __pu
__pi_min:
        LEA    __s_min
        JMP    __print_str

; Prints A, 0 to 32767, in decimal: the digits in front first, by recursion
__pu:
        ENTER  1
        STL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    10
        DIV
        TST
        JEQ    __pu_last
        CALL   __pu
__pu_last:
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    10
        MOD
        TAB
        LDI    '0'
        ADD
        OUT
        RET    2

; Data
__str0:   .STRING "FizzBuzz"
__str1:   .STRING "Fizz"
__str2:   .STRING "Buzz"
__s_min:  .STRING "32768"

programs.source:
; Compiled from C# by SharpC for SHARP-16
;
;   using System;
;
;   class Sieve
;   {
;       const int Limit = 200;
;
;       static void Main()
;       {
;           bool[] composite = new bool[Limit];
;           int count = 0;
;           for (int n = 2; n < Limit; n++)
;           {
;               if (composite[n]) continue;
;               Console.Write(n);
;               Console.Write(' ');
;               count++;
;               for (int m = n * n; m < Limit && m > 0; m += n)
;                   composite[m] = true;
;           }
;           Console.WriteLine();
;           Console.WriteLine($"{count} primes below {Limit}");
;       }
;   }

; SHARP-16 assembly, compiled from C# by SharpC

        CALL   Main
        HLT

; 7: static void Main()
Main:   ENTER  4        ; composite FP-1, count FP-2, n FP-3, m FP-4
; 9: bool[] composite = new bool[Limit];
        LDI    200
        CALL   __alloc
        STL    -1
; 10: int count = 0;
        LDI    0
        STL    -2
; 11: for (int n = 2; n < Limit; n++)
        LDI    2
        STL    -3
        JMP    __test3
__loop1:
; 13: if (composite[n]) continue;
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDL    -3
        ADD
        INC
        LDX
        TST
        JEQ    __else5
        JMP    __next2
__else5:
; 14: Console.Write(n);
        LDL    -3
        CALL   __print_int
; 15: Console.Write(' ');
        LDI    ' '
        OUT
; 16: count++;
        LDL    -2
        INC
        STL    -2
; 17: for (int m = n * n; m < Limit && m > 0; m += n)
        LDL    -3
        TAB
        LDL    -3
        MUL
        STL    -4
        JMP    __test8
__loop6:
; 18: composite[m] = true;
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDL    -4
        ADD
        INC
        TAB
        LDI    1
        STX
; 17: for (int m = n * n; m < Limit && m > 0; m += n)
        LDL    -4
        TAB
        LDL    -3
        ADD
        STL    -4
__test8:
        LDL    -4
        TAB
        LDI    200
        CMP
        JGE    __skip10
        LDL    -4
        TST
        JGT    __loop6
__skip10:
; 11: for (int n = 2; n < Limit; n++)
__next2:
        LDL    -3
        INC
        STL    -3
__test3:
        LDL    -3
        TAB
        LDI    200
        CMP
        JLT    __loop1
; 20: Console.WriteLine();
        LDI    10
        OUT
; 21: Console.WriteLine($"{count} primes below {Limit}");
        LDL    -2
        CALL   __print_int
        LEA    __str0
        CALL   __print_str
        LEA    __str1
        CALL   __print_str
        LDI    10
        OUT
        RET    2

; A = the address of a new array of A cells, its length stored in front
__alloc:
        ENTER  1
        STL    -1
        LD     __heap
        TAB
        LDL    -1
        STX
        ADD
        INC
        ST     __heap
        TBA
        RET    2

; Prints A as a signed decimal number
__print_int:
        TST
        JGE    __pu            ; not negative: print the digits
        TAB
        LDI    '-'
        OUT
        LDI    -32768
        CMP
        JEQ    __pi_min        ; -32768 has no positive twin
        TBA
        NEG
        JMP    __pu
__pi_min:
        LEA    __s_min
        JMP    __print_str

; Prints A, 0 to 32767, in decimal: the digits in front first, by recursion
__pu:
        ENTER  1
        STL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    10
        DIV
        TST
        JEQ    __pu_last
        CALL   __pu
__pu_last:
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    10
        MOD
        TAB
        LDI    '0'
        ADD
        OUT
        RET    2

; Prints the 0-terminated string at the address in A
__print_str:
        ENTER  1
        STL    -1
__ps_loop:
        LDL    -1
        LDX
        TST
        JEQ    __ps_done
        OUT
        LDL    -1
        INC
        STL    -1
        JMP    __ps_loop
__ps_done:
        RET    2

; Data
__str0:   .STRING " primes below "
__str1:   .STRING "200"
__s_min:  .STRING "32768"
__heap:   .DATA   __heap_start
; Arrays made with new are placed from here on, the stack grows down from the top
__heap_start:

programs.source:
; Compiled from C# by SharpC for SHARP-16
;
;   using System;
;
;   class Sorting
;   {
;       static void InsertionSort(int[] a)
;       {
;           for (int i = 1; i < a.Length; i++)
;           {
;               int key = a[i];
;               int j = i - 1;
;               while (j >= 0 && a[j] > key)
;               {
;                   a[j + 1] = a[j];
;                   j--;
;               }
;               a[j + 1] = key;
;           }
;       }
;
;       static void Print(string label, int[] a)
;       {
;           Console.Write(label);
;           foreach (int x in a)
;               Console.Write($" {x}");
;           Console.WriteLine();
;       }
;
;       static void Main()
;       {
;           int[] numbers = { 42, -7, 19, 0, 3, 1000, -250, 8, 8, 77 };
;           Print("before:", numbers);
;           InsertionSort(numbers);
;           Print("after: ", numbers);
;           Console.WriteLine($"min {numbers[0]}, max {numbers[numbers.Length - 1]}");
;       }
;   }

; SHARP-16 assembly, compiled from C# by SharpC

        CALL   Main
        HLT

; 5: static void InsertionSort(int[] a)
InsertionSort:
        ENTER  3        ; a FP+2, i FP-1, key FP-2, j FP-3
; 7: for (int i = 1; i < a.Length; i++)
        LDI    1
        STL    -1
        JMP    __test3
__loop1:
; 9: int key = a[i];
        LDL    2
        TAB
        LDL    -1
        ADD
        INC
        LDX
        STL    -2
; 10: int j = i - 1;
        LDL    -1
        DEC
        STL    -3
; 11: while (j >= 0 && a[j] > key)
        JMP    __test6
__loop5:
; 13: a[j + 1] = a[j];
        LDL    2
        PUSH
        LDL    -3
        INC
        POP
        ADD
        INC
        PUSH
        LDL    2
        TAB
        LDL    -3
        ADD
        INC
        LDX
        POP
        STX
; 14: j--;
        LDL    -3
        DEC
        STL    -3
; 11: while (j >= 0 && a[j] > key)
__test6:
        LDL    -3
        TST
        JLT    __skip8
        LDL    2
        TAB
        LDL    -3
        ADD
        INC
        LDX
        TAB
        LDL    -2
        CMP
        JGT    __loop5
__skip8:
; 16: a[j + 1] = key;
        LDL    2
        PUSH
        LDL    -3
        INC
        POP
        ADD
        INC
        TAB
        LDL    -2
        STX
; 7: for (int i = 1; i < a.Length; i++)
        LDL    -1
        INC
        STL    -1
__test3:
        LDL    -1
        PUSH
        LDL    2
        LDX
        POP
        CMP
        JLT    __loop1
        RET    3

; 20: static void Print(string label, int[] a)
Print:  ENTER  3        ; label FP+3, a FP+2, x FP-3
; 22: Console.Write(label);
        LDL    3
        CALL   __print_str
; 23: foreach (int x in a)
        LDL    2
        STL    -1
        LDI    0
        STL    -2
        JMP    __test11
__loop9:
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDL    -2
        ADD
        INC
        LDX
        STL    -3
; 24: Console.Write($" {x}");
        LDI    ' '
        OUT
        LDL    -3
        CALL   __print_int
; 23: foreach (int x in a)
        LDL    -2
        INC
        STL    -2
__test11:
        LDL    -2
        TAB
        LDL    -1
        LDX
        CMP
        JLT    __loop9
; 25: Console.WriteLine();
        LDI    10
        OUT
        RET    4

; 28: static void Main()
Main:   ENTER  2        ; numbers FP-2
; 30: int[] numbers = { 42, -7, 19, 0, 3, 1000, -250, 8, 8, 77 };
        LDI    10
        CALL   __alloc
        STL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    1

programs.description: A pixel wherever x AND y is 0, coloured with Screen.Rgb
programs.source:
; Compiled from C# by SharpC for SHARP-16
;
;   // A Sierpinski triangle: a pixel is lit where x AND y has no bits set
;   using System;
;
;   class Sierpinski
;   {
;       const int Size = 256;
;
;       static void Main()
;       {
;           Screen.Clear();
;           for (int y = 0; y < Size; y++)
;           {
;               Screen.MoveTo(192, y + 112);
;               for (int x = 0; x < Size; x++)
;               {
;                   int colour = (x & y) == 0 ? Screen.Rgb(x, y, 255 - x) : 0;
;                   Screen.Put(colour);
;               }
;           }
;           Console.Write("Sierpinski, drawn");
;       }
;   }

; SHARP-16 assembly, compiled from C# by SharpC

        CALL   Main
        HLT

; 8: static void Main()
Main:   ENTER  3        ; y FP-1, x FP-2, colour FP-3
; 10: Screen.Clear();
        CLS
; 11: for (int y = 0; y < Size; y++)
        LDI    0
        STL    -1
        JMP    __test3
__loop1:
; 13: Screen.MoveTo(192, y + 112);
        LDI    192
        PX
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    112
        ADD
        PY
; 14: for (int x = 0; x < Size; x++)
        LDI    0
        STL    -2
        JMP    __test7
__loop5:
; 16: int colour = (x & y) == 0 ? Screen.Rgb(x, y, 255 - x) : 0;
        LDL    -2
        TAB
        LDL    -1
        AND
        TST
        JNE    __else9
        LDL    -2
        TAB
        LDI    3
        SHR
        TAB
        LDI    11
        SHL
        PUSH
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    2
        SHR
        TAB
        LDI    5
        SHL
        POP
        OR
        PUSH
        LDI    255
        TAB
        LDL    -2
        SUB
        TAB
        LDI    3
        SHR
        POP
        OR
        JMP    __endif10
__else9:
        LDI    0
__endif10:
        STL    -3
; 17: Screen.Put(colour);
        PLOT
; 14: for (int x = 0; x < Size; x++)
        LDL    -2
        INC
        STL    -2
__test7:
        LDL    -2
        TAB
        LDI    256
        CMP
        JLT    __loop5
; 11: for (int y = 0; y < Size; y++)
        LDL    -1
        INC
        STL    -1
__test3:
        LDL    -1
        TAB
        LDI    256
        CMP
        JLT    __loop1
; 20: Console.Write("Sierpinski, drawn");
        LEA    __str0
        CALL   __print_str
        RET    2

; Prints the 0-terminated string at the address in A
__print_str:
        ENTER  1
        STL    -1
__ps_loop:
        LDL    -1
        LDX
        TST
        JEQ    __ps_done
        OUT
        LDL    -1
        INC
        STL    -1

;
;       static void Main()
;       {
;           int x = 320, y = 240, colour = 0;
;           Console.WriteLine("Arrow keys draw,");
;           Console.WriteLine("space changes colour");
;           while (true)
;           {
;               int keys = Keys.Read();
;               if ((keys & Keys.Left) != 0 && x > 0) x--;
;               if ((keys & Keys.Right) != 0 && x < 639) x++;
;               if ((keys & Keys.Up) != 0 && y > 0) y--;
;               if ((keys & Keys.Down) != 0 && y < 479) y++;
;               if ((keys & Keys.Space) != 0) colour = (colour + 1) % palette.Length;
;               Screen.Plot(x, y, palette[colour]);
;           }
;       }
;   }
